features.title: Everything you need to run a modern studio

features.moreSubtitle: Plenty of tools cover part of this. We built Linyup because we couldn't find one that covers it all at a fair price.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.detail: Build your weekly timetable in minutes — recurring classes, capacity limits, and attendance, all in one calendar.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: See your whole week at a glance.
calendar.detail: Your entire studio's week in one color-coded view, by activity and instructor — never double-book a room again.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.description: Every member profile in one place.
contacts.detail: A complete profile for every member — notes, history, ranks, and subscription status, always a click away.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.detail: Members reserve their spot in a tap and you get a clean, real-time roster for every single session.

checkins.title: Check-ins
checkins.description: Fast QR check-in at the door.
checkins.detail: Check members in with a quick scan — no clipboards, no spreadsheets, just an accurate attendance record.

trials.title: Trials
trials.detail: Capture every trial sign-up and nudge them toward a subscription with built-in follow-ups that convert.

memberships.title: Subscriptions
memberships.detail: Sell monthly, quarterly, or annual plans and track every renewal automatically — no spreadsheet required.

payments.title: Payments
payments.detail: Two ways to get paid: route payments through Linyup into your own Stripe account ('Pay via Linyup'), or bring your own gateway (BYO) and just track them here.

paymentFee.title: Linyup payment fee
paymentFee.detail: A small % on top of Stripe's fee — charged only when you collect with 'Pay via Linyup'. Bring your own gateway (BYO) and there's no Linyup fee.

biolink.title: Bio link
biolink.description: One link for everything you offer.
biolink.detail: One shareable link with your schedule, booking, and sign-up — perfect for your Instagram or TikTok bio.

website.title: Website
website.description: A booking site, ready out of the box.
website.detail: Launch a polished studio website with your schedule and pricing built in — no designer, no code.

customDomain.title: Custom domain
customDomain.description: Your pages on your own domain.
customDomain.detail: Serve your booking, shop and member pages from book.yourdomain.ch instead of a Linyup address. You add one DNS record; we issue and renew the certificate.

embeds.title: Embeds
embeds.description: Add Linyup to your own website.
embeds.detail: Already have a website? Embed your schedule, pricing, and other sections as widgets that stay in sync with Linyup — no rebuild, just paste a snippet.

mobileApp.title: Member app
mobileApp.description: iOS & Android app for your members.
mobileApp.detail: Your members get a branded iOS and Android app to book, check in, and stay in the loop wherever they are.

automations.title: Automations
automations.detail: Set it once and let Linyup welcome new contacts, send reminders, and win back lapsed ones — automatically.

gamification.title: Gamification
gamification.detail: Points, streaks, and badges that turn simply showing up into a habit your members genuinely love.

rankings.title: Rankings
rankings.detail: Track ranks, levels, and leaderboards that keep contacts chasing their next milestone — and coming back.

referrals.title: Referrals
referrals.detail: Reward contacts for bringing friends, with referrals tracked and credited automatically. Your best growth channel.

courses.title: Courses
courses.detail: Package your expertise into multi-week online courses your contacts can buy and follow at their own pace.

events.title: Events
events.detail: Run competitions, camps, and workshops with sign-ups, invitations, and check-in all built in.

eventForms.title: Event forms
eventForms.detail: Collect exactly the information you need at sign-up with fully custom fields for every event type.

groups.title: Groups
groups.detail: Organize contacts into squads, levels, or committees for targeted communication and effortless management.

customFields.title: Custom fields
customFields.description: Track exactly the data you need.
customFields.detail: Add the fields your studio actually needs and track any data on any contact — your CRM, your rules.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.detail: See attendance, retention, and engagement trends so you always know what's working — and what needs attention.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: Reach members where they already are.
whatsapp.detail: Send reminders, updates, and re-engagement messages on WhatsApp, right where your members already are.

appointments.title: Appointments
appointments.description: Bookable time with a specific coach.
appointments.detail: Publish availability slots clients book themselves from your bio link — with .ics calendar invites, reminders and buffer times. Your personal-trainer hook.

goals.title: Goals & progress
goals.detail: Set long-term goals and short-term tasks, log progress with photos and check-ins, and keep every member moving toward their next milestone.

products.title: Products shop
products.detail: Sell physical or digital products — merch, gear, bundles — from your public shop, paid straight into your own Stripe account.

forms.title: Forms
forms.detail: Build custom forms for sign-ups, intake, waivers and more — collect exactly the data you need, your way.

api.title: API access
api.detail: Programmatic access to your studio's data so you can integrate Linyup with your other tools and build custom workflows.

team.title: Team & roles
team.detail: Invite coaches and managers with the right permissions for each role — everyone sees exactly what they should.

finance.title: Finance & accounting
finance.description: Bookkeeping ledger + reports and CSV export.
finance.detail: A lightweight double-entry ledger — chart of accounts, automatic postings for every payment, manual entries, trial balance, P&L and balance sheet — plus monthly financial reports you can export as CSV for your accountant.

kiosk.title: Kiosk mode
kiosk.description: Turn an entrance tablet into a front-desk screen.
kiosk.detail: A fixed, low-chrome screen for the tablet at your entrance: live schedule, now/next class, a team check-in QR, walk-in signup, and a standby slideshow when idle.

places.title: Places & rooms
places.detail: Define your venues and the rooms inside them, then put a session in one. Rooms show on the booking page and the calendar, so nobody has to ask which door.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Publish what people need to read — and sign.
documents.detail: Share terms, house rules and information sheets on your public pages. Signable waivers, with frozen versions and a record of who accepted what, are available on Studio.

giftCards.title: Gift cards
giftCards.description: Sell credit someone else can spend.
giftCards.detail: Sell a gift card in your shop, and let the recipient spend it on classes, memberships, courses or products. Balances are tracked for you, and an outstanding card is money already taken.

promoCodes.title: Promo codes
promoCodes.description: Run a campaign without discounting everything.
promoCodes.detail: Create a code that cuts the price of a drop-in, an appointment, a course or a product. Limit it by use, by date, by audience or to one person — and see what each code actually earned.

migration.title: We migrate your data for you
migration.subtitle: Moving from another tool is the worst part of switching — so leave it to us. We bring over your contacts, schedule, subscriptions and history. You just review the result and tell us what to adjust.
migration.badge: Free white-glove migration for early adopters

send.title: Send us your data
send.detail: An export or spreadsheet from your current tool — whatever you already have.

migrate.title: We do the heavy lifting
migrate.detail: We map and import your contacts, schedule, subscriptions and history into Linyup.

review.title: You review & instruct
review.detail: Check the result and just tell us what to adjust. Nothing goes live until it's right.

payments.title: Get paid. Sell online. Keep what's yours.
payments.subtitle: Take subscriptions and drop-ins straight into your own Stripe account, and open a public shop in minutes — no middleman holding your money.

sell.title: Sell online

pay.title: Accept payments
pay.linyupBody: TWINT + cards, fully integrated with your offers. We do not hold your money — payments land straight in your own Stripe account. Fees apply,

shop.title: A shop that grows with you

twint.title: TWINT + cards
twint.body: Accept the methods Swiss customers actually use — including recurring subscriptions on TWINT.

payments.proof: A subscription paid by TWINT on the Studio tier costs roughly half what card-only international tools charge.
payments.feesIntro: Charged on top of Stripe's standard fee, which we pass through at cost. Percentage only — no fixed per-transaction Linyup fee. Same rate on cards and TWINT.
payments.feesMicrocopy: You see exactly what you pay: Stripe's processing fee at cost, plus a small Linyup percentage on the payments you take. No fixed per-transaction fee, no markup on Stripe's cut.

founder.heading: Why I made Linyup
body: I coach at a club in Basel, so I've lived the admin: the spreadsheets, the chasing, the software that feels built for accountants, not coaches.
Most tools are clumsy and expensive, and it's no accident. A lot of them run on decades-old technology, so every improvement is slow and costly, and you pay for that.

I'm also a software engineer, so I do things differently. Linyup is made by a small team with an AI-first approach, so we can ship real features in days, keep it simple, and charge a fair price instead of enterprise rates. It also means we can add what you actually need. Tell me the one thing your current tool can't do, and there's a good chance it'll be in Linyup next week.
That's the whole idea: a modern, honest, affordable tool for coaches, studios and clubs, built with the people who use it.
If that sounds like your kind of thing, I'd love a few founding partners to shape it with.
